Changes.note: “Yayın iste” sends your request to Medaris management; the deck stays private until a reviewer publishes it, and the approval or refusal reaches your notifications. A published deck is read and collected by everyone, visitors who are not signed in too; köşk and course decks can be published this way, a course deck in draft as well. When you change a published deck’s name, description or cards, the change reaches everyone without a new review. “İsteği geri çek” and “Özele çek” make the deck yours alone again; a refused deck also goes back to private with “Özele çek” and can then be requested again. “Desteyi sil” deletes the deck and its cards for good, and the deck leaves everyone’s collection; it cannot be undone.
